title: Wario Land: Shake It!
subtitle: Wario follows the promise of endless money
summary: Wario Land: Shake It! is Good-Feel's Wii side-scrolling platformer sending Wario into the Shake Dimension in pursuit of a Bottomless Coin Sack. Known in Europe as The Shake Dimension, it presents the greedy adventurer through hand-drawn animation and broad physical comedy. Holding the Remote sideways retains a familiar platform-game arrangement, while shaking and tilting add actions suited to Wario's strength and impatience. Rescuing the inhabitants provides the journey's immediate task, but the promise of an inexhaustible fortune is what persuades its unlikely hero to become involved.
body: Wario Land: Shake It! is Good-Feel's Wii side-scrolling platformer sending Wario into the Shake Dimension in pursuit of a Bottomless Coin Sack. Known in Europe as The Shake Dimension, it presents the greedy adventurer through hand-drawn animation and broad physical comedy. Holding the Remote sideways retains a familiar platform-game arrangement, while shaking and tilting add actions suited to Wario's strength and impatience. Rescuing the inhabitants provides the journey's immediate task, but the promise of an inexhaustible fortune is what persuades its unlikely hero to become involved.

Wario can stun enemies, pick them up and shake them to release items. Coin bags respond to the same treatment, making the controller movement a direct expression of his enthusiasm for money. A forceful ground punch affects nearby enemies and mechanisms, while tilting helps aim thrown objects. Vehicle sections also use tilt controls. These additions build on the shoulder charge and heavy landing that already define Wario's movement, giving the motion controls specific jobs inside the platforming instead of replacing every familiar action with another gesture.

Breaking the cage at the end of most stages frees a Merfle and starts a countdown. Wario then has to return to the entrance before time expires, using machines that launch him into a fast dash. Maintaining that speed can break obstacles and reach otherwise inaccessible treasure. The same landscape must therefore support a careful outward exploration and a much quicker return. Hidden valuables and optional objectives encourage another visit, rewarding players who learn how the route fits together and where Wario can keep his momentum through the escape.
story_headings: Wario follows the promise of endless money
Shake something and see what falls out
The journey back becomes a race
